info.name: WHOOP Activity ID Mapping Partner API
info.description:
The WHOOP API exposes member fitness, strain, recovery, sleep, workout, and body measurement data captured by the WHOOP wrist-worn wearable. OAuth 2.0 protected; v2 endpoints use UUID identifiers and webhook notifications keep integrations current.

Contact Support:
 Name: WHOOP Developer Support
